name: Graffism
summary:
Step into a VR graffiti world where creativity flows freely. This immersive painting simulator lets you create art on any surface within your reach giving you room to express yourself like never before.
Use a variety of tools: spray cans, markers and even fire extinguishers. Paint across richly detailed urban locations or visit the paint shop to decorate individual objects in your own style.
Customize your avatar with a wide selection of clothes and accessories.
It’s your creative freedom in VR.
